title: Transverse vibration of a tensioned rectangular bar
source: Independent Euler–Bernoulli clamped-clamped beam with axial tension; roots are evaluated by the standard-library bisection in reference.py.

quantities.reason: The Euler–Bernoulli clamped-clamped tensioned-beam root is an independent reference. The 20-node solid omits the beam theory's shear and rotary-inertia idealisations; the standard-library estimate rho*omega^2/(kappa*G) is below the measured solid-versus-beam difference, so the stated band is the documented beam-model applicability allowance. The measured difference is −0.09%; weak-axis first uses a 0.5% band.
